messages:
Ben (People Ops): Team — new manager joins next Tue. I'm assembling a compact "Manager Sprint-Zero" packet: pre-start checklist, first-week agenda, and a one-page 30/60/90 scaffold that managers can hand back to their skip-level. Need quick input on items we must include (especially access & escalation flow).

Maya (HR): Must-haves: payroll setup checklist, benefits enrollment link + deadline, manager handbook PDF, and probation review milestone (90 days). Also assign a benefits buddy.

Diego (IT): I'll stage laptop + SSO image. Common failure modes: SCIM group delay, repo admin missing, and Datadog dashboard perms. Plan: pre-create IT ticket and attach a "Start Triage" zoom link in the prestart email. If blocked > 2 hours, ping me + start that link.

Nora (Hiring Manager): Please include a 1-paragraph "What success looks like" blurb for the role to put on the 30/60/90 sheet. Also we need a clear owner for sign-off (I prefer the skip-level).

Sam (Eng Manager): Add a short "first 7-day manager checklist" with practical items: 1) set recurring 1:1s, 2) review last 3 retros and open action items, 3) check on-call rota & runbook owners, 4) identify a 30-day quick win.

Ben (People Ops): Draft prestart email (send 48h out):
```
Subject: Welcome — quick prestart items
Hi {{name}},
Two quick asks before Tue: 1) upload photo ID to payroll form, 2) confirm laptop delivery window, 3) click the SSO invite and complete auth.
Links: benefits, manager handbook, onboarding packet, IT triage link
See you Tue at 09:00 for a short kickoff.
```

Maya (HR): Add note: "Bring original ID or corporate letter for payroll verification". Also confirm their manager training slot in Week 2.

Diego (IT): I'll include a short troubleshooting snippet in the packet for common git/ssh issues:
```
# common fix for repo clone errors
ssh-add ~/.ssh/id_rsa || eval "$(ssh-agent -s)" && ssh-add ~/.ssh/id_rsa
```

Ben (People Ops): Proposed Day 1 agenda (compact):
- 09:00 Welcome + admin (HR)
- 09:45 Access verification (IT)
- 10:30 Team & cross-func intros (Hiring mgr + Eng mgr)
- 12:00 Lunch with assigned buddy
- 13:30 30/60/90 sketch (15min) + expectations (skip-level)
- 14:00 Tools walkthrough (OKRs, dashboards, incident playbooks)
- 16:00 EOD with People Ops (confirm outstanding blocks)

Sam (Eng Manager): For the 30/60/90 template, suggest columns: Objective, Success metric, Key milestones, Risks/blockers, Sign-off. Keep each cell one-line where possible.

Ben (People Ops): Here's a compact 30/60/90 sample we can attach (one-line cells):
- 30d: Get team to green on sprint health; metric: all high-priority sprint tasks triaged and at least one PR merged by day 30.
- 60d: Own a cross-team feature or operational domain; metric: feature milestone met + stakeholder alignment meeting held.
- 90d: Deliver end-to-end outcome and embed feedback loop; metric: stakeholder satisfaction + reduced cycle time by X%.

Nora (Hiring Manager): Looks good. I'll add the role blurb and sign-off owner. Also let's include who to cc for urgent HR/legal questions.

Maya (HR): I'll assign a benefits buddy and confirm payroll set-up by Day 3. Also adding benefits enrollment deadline to the packet so new managers don't miss it.

Diego (IT): Created IT ticket #IT-ONB-1971 and queued SCIM group sync. ETA for full access: usually within 24 hours if ticket created today. Posting the ticket link in the packet when resolved.

Ben (People Ops): Escape hatch: if any essential access is missing for >2 hours on Day 1, new manager should: 1) click the "Start IT Triage" link in the packet, 2) ping @Diego and @Onboarding Bot with the ticket id, 3) People Ops will schedule an immediate Zoom.

Sam (Eng Manager): Can we add an "Ops quick reference" one-pager with runbook owners, oncall rota link, and incident triage steps? New managers keep asking for that.

Ben (People Ops): Yes — adding "Ops Quickref" annex: runbook links, pager contacts, and a one-line incident flow.

Onboarding Bot: Reminder scheduled: send prestart email 48h before, send Day 1 agenda 24h before, schedule Week1 check-in at Day 7.

Ben (People Ops): Action owners summary: Diego = access + IT ticket, Maya = payroll + benefits buddy, Nora = role blurb & skip-level signoff, Sam = team intros & ops quickref, Ben = final packet + calendar templates. I'll post the live packet link here by EOD tomorrow. Please drop any example 30/60/90s or fast-win ideas in this thread. :thumbsup: 

Nora (Hiring Manager): I'll DM a short "success blurb" for the role now.

Maya (HR): Adding manager training invite for Week 2 — will CC in packet.

Diego (IT): Ticket updated — linking to packet once pre-provisioning done.

Ben (People Ops): Closing thread for now; will reopen if any blockers. Final packet link will be: https://redwoodinc.slack.com/archives/people-ops/p-manager-sprint-zero-packet :party_parrot:
